description: This file defines an internal class GenericAsyncBatchObserver<T> that implements the IAsyncBatchObserver<T> interface. It facilitates asynchronous observation of batched stream data by invoking provided delegate functions for onNext, onError, and onCompleted events.

classes.name: GenericAsyncBatchObserver<T>
classes.description: An internal class used for observing batched stream items asynchronously via delegate functions.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Invokes the delegate to handle the next batch of items asynchronously.

methods.name: OnCompletedAsync
methods.description: Invokes the delegate to handle the stream completion asynchronously.

methods.name: OnErrorAsync
methods.description: Invokes the delegate to handle errors asynchronously.
